primary_endpoint: Composite of access site-related major or minor vascular complications at 30 days.
efficacy_outcome: MANTA was not superior to ProGlide for vascular complications (10% vs. 4%; p = 0.16). Modified closure-device failure was lower with MANTA (20% vs. 40%; p < 0.01).
safety_signal: Clinically significant access site bleeding occurred in 9% with MANTA versus 6% with ProGlide (p = 0.57).
